say:1:1330507001:1.text: We'll do a thorough cleaning before the ceremony. Once we've finished, the temple will look just like how it was before.
say:1:1330507001:1.source_cn: 我们会先将教堂内外清理干净，再进行净化仪式。等我们做完...
say:1:1330507001:1.male: We'll do a thorough cleaning before the ceremony. Once we've finished, the temple will look just like how it was before.
say:1:1330507001:1.female: We'll do a thorough cleaning before the ceremony. Once we've finished, the temple will look just like how it was before.

say:2:1330507002:1.text: It doesn't mean we'll forget what has happened here. Dura above, may evil never return.
say:2:1330507002:1.source_cn: 但我们不会因此忘记这里发生过的一切。艾雅在上，愿邪恶永...
